name: Time tracking
description: The report of your booked time: the week and the month, with booking, suggestions and closing the week.

items.title: Delete a job or a project

flow.name: zeiterfassung.job-delete
flow.title: Delete a job or a project
flow.description: Deletes a job or a project (input kind job|project, id). Run by the Jobs tab.

items.title: Book the working days on a project

flow.name: zeiterfassung.book-days
flow.title: Book the working days on a project
flow.description: One entry per working day of a range on a project (input id, from, to, hours, fillUp, description, type). Run by the Jobs tab.

items.title: Edit an entry, its group or a day's break

flow.name: zeiterfassung.entry-op
flow.title: Edit an entry, its group or a day's break
flow.description: One edit of the weekly report (input op update|copy|link|unlink|collect|start|span-mode|ungroup|parallel|pauses and its fields). Run by the report.

flow.name: zeiterfassung.rule-op
flow.title: Change a list of rules
flow.description: One change of a list of rules or of the entry types (input what types|report|meetings|exclude|entry-type, op add|remove|up|down|default|update|none, index, apply, and the rule's fields). Run by the Settings tab.

flow.name: zeiterfassung.day-book
flow.title: Book the day
flow.description: The day's lines booked as you took them over (input date, state: the view's state as JSON). Run by the End of day tab.

flow.name: zeiterfassung.day-undo
flow.title: Take the day's booking back
flow.description: Takes back what a booking of the day created, as far as it is still as booked (input created). Run by the End of day tab.

flow.name: zeiterfassung.schedule-save
flow.title: Save the schedule
flow.description: The weekly hours, the default break or the flex-time job (input what hours|pauses|flex, mon … sun, text, jobNumber, comment). Run by the Settings tab.

flow.name: zeiterfassung.absence-book
flow.title: Book absences on their jobs
flow.description: The absence hours of the given days (input dates) booked on the job of their kind of absence. Run by the report's absence rows.

items.title: Book the missing hours on the flex-time job

flow.name: zeiterfassung.flex-book
flow.title: Book the missing hours on the flex-time job
flow.description: The missing hours of the given days (input dates) booked on the flex-time job. Run by the report.

flow.name: zeiterfassung.absence
flow.title: Add or delete an absence
flow.description: An absence added (startDate, endDate, type, hours, note, repeatUntil) or deleted (input delete: its id). Run by the Settings tab.

flow.name: zeiterfassung.job-save
flow.title: Create or change a job
flow.description: A job: without id created, with id changed (number, name, customer, description, defaultTags, active). Run by the Jobs tab.

flow.name: zeiterfassung.project-save
flow.title: Create or change a project
flow.description: A project: without id created, with id changed (title, description, customer, jobNumber, startDate, endDate, defaultTags, active). Run by the Jobs tab.

flow.name: zeiterfassung.add-entry
flow.title: Book time
flow.description: Books an entry (input date, hours, description, bookOn j:<job number> or p:<project id>, ticket, type, tags, comment). Run by the report's form.

items.title: Change the hours of an entry

flow.name: zeiterfassung.entry-hours
flow.title: Change the hours of an entry
flow.description: Sets the hours of one entry (input id, hours). Run by the report.

flow.name: zeiterfassung.delete-entry
flow.title: Delete an entry
flow.description: Deletes one booked entry (input id). Run by the report.

items.title: Take over or dismiss a suggested entry

flow.name: zeiterfassung.suggestion
flow.title: Take over or dismiss a suggested entry
flow.description: An agent's suggested booking (input id, accept true|false, hours, description). Run by the report.

flow.name: zeiterfassung.done-today
flow.title: Book the todos done today
flow.description: A ticket's todos done today booked as one entry, or skipped (input ticket, todoIds, hours, description, skip). Run by the report.
